title: Save exactly N tape reads in a marked binary countdown (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Cache the terminating ONE in the retained marked binary countdown. A complete countdown from N saves exactly N tape reads. Every intermediate value, delimiter, head, write, move and blank return is preserved.

```diff
- need(tape.read() == ONE)
+ need(the_symbol_already_read == ONE)
```

Claim type: scoped implementation-equivalence proof and exact logical-tape invoice, with finite corroboration. The new positive-N complete bill is `14N + 14d - 5 popcount(N) + 36`. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

The unchanged linear-sign caller saves exactly `B [3M-4 + 4(M-2)S + M S 1_{S>1}]` reads. The change is supplied in one isolated package and substituted into the actual retained caller during verification.

## Evidence

Before and after at (M,B,S)=(65,1,1): 24,454 to 24,011 logical read/write/unit-move operations. At (65,3,7), the saving is 7,230 reads. Neither fixture changes writes or moves. These are exact operation counts, not wall-clock speedups.

- All 387 count/padding cases and 24,768 intermediate decrement states pass.
- Thirty complete caller pairs cover 4,160 output addresses. Every source coordinate, actual payload bit, borrowed extent/numerical state, closed private counter and complete traffic delta passes.
- Finished counters and invalid borrow terminators reject.
- Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only: normal direct replay 0.4905s, optimized direct replay 0.6204s, registered replay 1.3444s. Both registered commands have a 60s timeout.
- Metadata/pins, exact committed bytes and source ancestry pass for head `9ba6f43b4d1da64e250f948a8e684011ef9fb0c6`. The official 15-file export passes integrity checking and optimized read-only replay with Git absent from PATH.

Exact reproduction, from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/marked-countdown-cached-borrow
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/marked-countdown-cached-borrow/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/marked-countdown-cached-borrow/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/marked-countdown-cached-borrow --check-source-history
```

An equivalent CPython 3.12 executable can replace that path. Direct output contains `PASS_MARKED_COUNTDOWN_CACHED_BORROW`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. RESULT.json is generated, compared on replay and bound to all other package files by SHA256.

## Credit and scope

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Arham Tahir / [PR2877](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2877) for the complete countdown and sign invoices, David Arias / [PR2753](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2753) for linear sign, and Jose Manuel / PR2697 for the marked Counter and binary tape library. The new result is the changed decrement and its exact saving. No predecessor scientific checker is imported or replayed.

Base main and submission refresh are `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The uniform-transfer-audit card is explicitly changed to an implementation and ordinary-cost side result. The [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363491) predicted both cached reads and fewer rewinds; delivery stops at the first verified improvement, cached reads. All rewinds remain paid.

The written induction is the all-parameter argument; finite cases are corroboration. This is no optimal-transducer claim, physical machine compiler, complete caller integration, supplier admission, or complete multiplication theorem. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Native/outer, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unrun or unclaimed. Frozen predecessor files and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Can a finite-control return path remove known-position rewind work? First price every borrow-length/top-marker case, preserving private-tape restoration.
- Can a current complete caller adopt the replacement? Pin its exact Counter ABI and alias imports, then charge the full physical control trace.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this marked Counter or the complete linear-sign traffic was identified in the 434-open-body cache and latest 100-open-PR refresh. Completion refresh inspected this account's 96 open PRs, including all 13 created since the CLAIM at 2026-11-03T00:48:17Z. None of the other 12 studies this Counter or computes the complete linear-sign traffic; no numerical disagreement was identified. Source PR2877 and PR2753 are retained predecessors. Sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain overlap limits.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `9ba6f43b4d1da64e250f948a8e684011ef9fb0c6` in [run 41556141416](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41556141416): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41556141416/job/125655375743) in 4m28s and [registered replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41556141416/job/125657017687) in 1m17s. The completed checks were read once and the current PR head matches that commit. Hosted CI certifies the registered normal/optimized finite replay; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed. All recorded local checks also passed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Eight added files in one opt-in package, with seven declared unchanged runtime inputs.
